source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Blue litmus staying blue proves that a substance is basic.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A solution that turns red litmus blue but does not feel slippery is not basic.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Bitter gourd is basic because it tastes bitter.

intelligence.enrichment: Basic substances such as baking soda solution may feel slippery and turn red litmus blue, but bitter taste alone does not prove that a substance is basic. observable_property_plus_indicator_response -> basic_nature_decision student names baking soda or soap but cannot tell which observation would show basic nature

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Identify common basic substances using slippery feel and indicator evidence while avoiding the bitter-equals-base shortcut. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key.
